engine: Apollo-like (error shape) — lab build (Server header says so)

findings.name: GET-based queries (CSRF angle)
findings.evidence: GET-based queries work: the same query runs over GET (curl 'http://127.0.0.1:4001/graphql?query={%20__typename%20}'). If this API ever uses cookie auth, that is a CSRF vector.
findings.fix: Accept GraphQL only over POST with a JSON body, or require a CSRF token / custom header on GET.

introspection.evidence: Introspection refused with and without a token: ['Introspection is disabled']

bypass.evidence: All bypasses refused (tried: __type, GET, newline, fragment)

depth.evidence: Refused past depth 5: Query depth 8 exceeds maximum 5

batching.evidence: Array batching refused (a single error object, not an array).

alias.evidence: The alias bomb was refused: ['Too many aliases in one query (101 > 10)']

duplication.evidence: Duplicate fields refused: ["Field '__typename' repeated 50 times in one selection set (max 2)"]

directive.evidence: Directives refused with one error: ["Too many directives on field '__typename' (10 > 2)"]

authz.evidence: No protected field answered without a token.

guessing.evidence: Guessing found 2 public fields, no suggestions leaked and no protected field confirmed.

mutation.evidence: No mutation executed without a token.

fingerprint.verdict: Apollo-like (error shape) — lab build (Server header says so)
fingerprint.evidence: Server header: BaseHTTP/0.6 Python/3.12.3, GQLProbe-Lab/1.0; error shape: 'Cannot query field ...'

get.evidence: The cheapest query executes over GET.

injection.evidence: Quoted arguments returned clean results — no database error leaked.

sensitive.evidence: No schema to flag (introspection is off), and the passwordHash spot-check returned nothing without a token. A full check needs the schema — see the introspection probe.

timing.evidence: Shallow 0.005s, deep 0.000s, 1 vs 100 batch 0.002s vs 0.005s; rate limit kicked in at request 11/20.
